title: Plant Manager
text:
## Overview

We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Plant Manager to lead our operations at our facility in Canton, OH, 44720. As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of plant operations, ensuring efficiency, safety, and quality standards are met. If you have a passion for manufacturing and a knack for team leadership, we want to hear from you!

## Responsibilities

* Oversee daily plant operations and manage production schedules to meet customer demands.
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations and promote a culture of safety among all employees.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of supervisors and staff to achieve operational excellence.
* Monitor and analyze production metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions.
* Manage budgets and control costs to optimize plant profitability.
* Collaborate with other departments, including quality assurance, maintenance, and supply chain, to ensure seamless operations.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and foster a culture of innovation within the plant.
* Prepare and present reports on plant performance to senior management.

 **Qualifications**
 ------------------
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in a manufacturing environment, with at least 3 years in a management role.
* Strong understanding of production processes, quality control, and safety standards.
* Proven leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop a diverse team.
* Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficient in using manufacturing software and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.

You should be proficient in:

* Foundry Environment Experience
* Casting
* CNC
* Foundry
* Machine Shop
* MANUFACTURING MANAGER
* OPERATIONS MANAGER
* PLANT DIRECTOR
* Plant Manager
* PLANT SUPERINTENDENT
* PRODUCTION MANAGER
* Steel
